description: Get the AI-generated analysis report of r/wallstreetbets daily discussion threads. Reports cover market sentiment, trending tickers, notable trades, community mood, and contrarian signals. Each day may have multiple analysis runs as new comments accumulate. Use 'offset' to step back through earlier report posts and 'run' to view a specific analysis run of one post.

offset.description: Report-post offset, newest first: 0 = the latest daily-discussion post, 1 = the one before, etc. A trading day usually has 2 posts, so this is not a day count. Default: 0

run.description: Specific analysis run index within a day (0-indexed). Each day may have multiple runs as new comments come in. Omit for the latest run.

name: get_wsb_analysis
